title.text: Budapest: Private Sightseeing Tour by Car with Guide and Driver

pills.pop_html: Timing: Book 3 hours for the highlights or up to 8. Suggested start 8.30–10 am.
Guided in: English, German or Hungarian.
Access: ♿ Wheelchair: ✓ listed as wheelchair accessible🎟️ Kids: ⓘ no age limit given
Who comes: A professional local guide and a separate professional driver, so the guide talks to you instead of watching the road.
Transport: An air-conditioned car picks you up and drops you off wherever you choose in the city. Parking fees, taxes and a bottle of water are included.

Route: Andrássy Avenue and the Opera, Heroes' Square (45 minutes on foot), the Basilica, Parliament (25 minutes), a drive over Margaret Bridge, an hour walking Castle Hill, Liberty Bridge, the Gellért Hill view and the Jewish Quarter.
Price: Per person for the 3-hour tour: about €39 an hour. Entrance fees and meals are extra.
What it feels like: Short walks at the big sights and the car in between; a guide who talks history, culture and food.

title.text: Budapest: Buda Castle Private Walking Tour

pills.pop_html: Timing: A 3-hour walk; extend into Watertown on request.
Guided in: English-speaking private guide. Entrance fees, food and tips are extra.
Access: ♿ Wheelchair: ✕ not for wheelchair users or limited mobility👶 Stroller: ✕ not for babies under 1🎟️ Kids: ⓘ no minimum age given beyond babies under 1
The story: From the 13th century and the 15th-century golden age through the Ottoman and Habsburg eras to the 1944–45 siege, told on the walls, at Matthias Church and Fisherman's Bastion.
Optional: Extend the walk on request into Watertown, the narrow streets between the Danube and Castle Hill.
Start: Pick-up is listed; the details show when you check availability. Public transport costs are extra.
Per person: €120 for the group: €20 each with 6, €30 with 4, €60 with 2.
What it feels like: Cobbles, castle walls and 700 years of stories, with the best view of Pest from the walls.

best_for.pick_html: for history lovers in a group of 3 to 6: a private guide on Castle Hill for €20–40 each, the cheapest private guide here per head
best_for.skip_html: if you want the whole city: it covers the Castle District only; book #1 or #2 for both banks
